svg.title: Twelve K230 to dual x16 LPDDR4 placements
svg.desc: The 390-ball Canaan K230 stays fixed. Two 200-ball Micron x16 memories move together to each of four sides and three offsets. All 790 physical pads are shown. Orange pads carry 65 SoC signals and 33 signals on each RAM, including shared reset. Placement preview only; routes are not shown.
svg.text: 390-ball NPU SoC · two 200-ball single-rank RAMs · 12 physical placements
Package placement preview · routes not shown
